versions.changelog:
- Initial public release of SenseAudio Jingle Forge.
- Creates custom brand jingles (5–15s) from brand name and tone keywords.
- Collects brand info, generates concise lyrics to strict rules, and matches music style to tone.
- Produces two jingle versions for each brand: with vocals and instrumental.
- Generates a spoken brand name audio clip for overlay use.
- Guides on best usage scenarios for each output.
